summary.en: The stream mascot slot: an anchor at the top of the thread with four poses (sit, drop, squash on landing, wound into a point); by default the style's own ball of thread drawn in code, or the film's own mascot as an image at the same anchor.
summary.zh: stream 的吉祥物位：线顶端的锚点，四种姿态（坐着、落下、落地压扁、缠成一个点）；默认是代码画的线团，也可以换成片子自己的吉祥物图片，锚点不变。

fits: A product with a mascot or a character; the root the thread grows from.
notFor: Brands without a mascot that must not have one; people or photographs.

intent.en: Give the thread a root the viewer can recognise: the product itself, sitting where all the work comes back to.
intent.zh: 给线一个能认出来的根：产品本身，坐在所有事最后回到的地方。

content.en: Nothing to read: an optional image of the film's own mascot; a size for the box it fills (30–160 px, default 60).
content.zh: 没有字：可选的一张片子自己的吉祥物图片；可设它填满的框的大小（30–160 px，默认 60）。

fits.zh: 有吉祥物或角色的产品；线长出来的根。

notFor.zh: 明确不要吉祥物的品牌；真人或照片。

pairs.note: the mascot ending of the lock-up

en: A swapped image is drawn at the same anchor and size: give it a transparent background and its own visual centre at the middle.
The squash on landing is the only bounce in the style; do not add more.
zh: 换上的图片画在同一锚点同一尺寸：用透明底，视觉中心放在正中。
落地压扁是这个风格里唯一的弹跳，不要再加。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js mascot(), renderOpen (the drop), renderLock (the point)
